verdict.rationale: Railway documents in-platform scaling of the same deployed services: vertical CPU/RAM scaling, replicas with load balancing, load balancing available from the first deploy, and running closer to users. That suggests a continuous path from prototype upward without changing platforms. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly claims or shows continuity of APIs and primitives up to massive scale, or growth without rearchitecting. Missing for 10: documented scaling limits or ceilings, an explicit prototype-to-massive-scale continuity claim, and independent or hands-on reports of scaling large workloads on Railway without migration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the same core APIs and primitives from prototype through massive scale, without rearchitecting or migrating platforms as usage grows

citations.quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
Run your application closer to where your users are.
